cases.name: setup: create story
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.story_create({name:"monitor-test",title:"Monitor Test",description:"test",type:"feature",priority:"high"}); $ctx.sid = r.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; return r

cases.name: test_auto handler returns JSON with core fields
story_get returns structured data
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.story_get({storyId:$ctx.sid}); return typeof r === 'string' || typeof r === 'object'

cases.name: bug_list returns structured result
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.bug_list({storyId:$ctx.sid}); return r.bugs !== undefined && Array.isArray(r.bugs)

cases.name: fixture_get returns cases array
cases.execute: $handlers.fixture_batch_add({fixturePath:"_tmp_mon_fg",cases:[{name:"t",run_type:"cli",fn:"story_get",file:"mcp/handlers/story",execute:"return true",expect:true}]}); const r = $handlers.fixture_get({fixturePath:"_tmp_mon_fg"}); return r.cases.length === 1 && typeof r.cases[0]._id === 'string'

cases.name: story_list returns structured dashboard
cases.execute: const r = $handlers.story_list(); return typeof r === 'string' && (r.includes('stories') || r.includes('Story'))

cases.name: diagnose returns valid JSON or error
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"nonexistent"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.error !== undefined || typeof d.gitDiff === 'string'
